candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Internship Management Consulting – Data Science/Data Analytics
letter.opening: I am applying for the internship in BASF Management Consulting – Data Science/Data Analytics from January 2027. The role asks for Python, Streamlit-style frontends and experience with large language models, which is exactly what I used to build my latest project.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. Before my Master's I worked in SAP data and analytics consulting at TallyMarks Consulting and as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea.

achievements.impact: I built a RAG application with the Claude API, a Streamlit UI and a FastAPI REST API; it answered 91% of a 22-question test set correctly and refused all 4 unanswerable questions
I prepared and presented an SAP Analytics Cloud presentation to a client, who subsequently purchased it
I translated business requirements into KPI dashboards in SAP Analytics Cloud and documented sources and calculations for each one

letter.problems_section: I would build analyses and small tools for the consultants, with Python, Streamlit and LLMs where they help, and present results clearly. My consulting experience is from a junior role, so I would learn the strategy side from your team.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Ludwigshafen and can start in January 2027. As a non-EU student I will agree the internship length with you so it fits my permitted working days. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
